unknown_policy: A nonzero primitive_invalid_plan_ring count is reported explicitly. Any unevaluated_count remains unknown; it is never converted to zero findings. Failed tracks and missing context remain null/unevaluated.
source_fingerprint_note: Canonical hashes cover the complete response audio_features and architectural_score objects; equal hashes indicate equal serialized payloads under the stated canonicalization, not a visual verdict.
